label: BRAT merges loadData over DEFAULT_SETTINGS, so missing persisted keys inherit defaults at runtime.
The source default schema includes pluginList, pluginSubListFrozenVersion, themesList, startup/update/install/logging flags, token-name fields, and compatibility toggles.
pluginList is repo strings; pluginSubListFrozenVersion contains repo/version/tokenName/isIncompatible metadata; themesList contains repo plus checksum lastUpdate.
Frozen versions are skipped during update sweeps only when version is truthy and not latest.
PluginCommands registers every command by looping bratCommands through plugin.addCommand.
BRAT uses GitHub release APIs and exact release assets for main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css.
Official docs align with source that users provide repository paths and BRAT handles downloads, updates, and reloads.
Theme tracking uses themesList and checksum-style lastUpdate, with docs stating BRAT downloads theme-beta.css before theme.css and writes theme.css plus manifest.json to the themes folder.
